results.check: Camera list and per-camera properties read from the catalogue API
results.evidence: synced 0 new + 14 existing from http://localhost:8010; 14 cameras carry catalogue-sourced properties (codec, resolution, fps, location); 0 unmappable records

results.check: Every client forces RTSP over TCP
results.evidence: analytics workers: OPENCV_FFMPEG_CAPTURE_OPTIONS='rtsp_transport;tcp|stimeout;5000000|max_delay;500000'; media relay pulls with rtspTransport=tcp; simulator publishes with -rtsp_transport tcp

results.check: No timing logic depends on CAP_PROP_FPS or on frame arrival time
results.evidence: CAP_PROP_FPS is recorded for reporting only; event time = stream PTS anchored once, with a documented fallback. AMD-AMC-001: 240/240 distinct frame timestamps, max |frame-time - arrival-time| drift 3.53s, stream PTS · AMD-AMC-002: 250/250 distinct frame timestamps, max |frame-time - arrival-time| drift 1.43s, stream PTS · GNR-POL-002: 130/130 distinct frame timestamps, max |frame-time - arrival-time| drift 1.03s, stream PTS

results.check: Inter-frame gaps do not crash or stall the pipeline
results.evidence: 3/3 streams connected at the end; latest-frame semantics mean a gap lowers the analysis rate instead of queueing. AMD-AMC-001: longest gap between delivered frames 2.3s, still delivering at the end (yes) · AMD-AMC-002: longest gap between delivered frames 2.3s, still delivering at the end (yes) · GNR-POL-002: longest gap between delivered frames 33.6s, still delivering at the end (yes)

results.check: Reconnect with backoff, tested by restarting a feed
results.evidence: GNR-POL-002: feed cut mid-run; 2 connection attempts, backoff 2s doubling to a 30s cap; reconnected and delivering again: yes

results.check: Decoder warnings on join are logged, not fatal
results.evidence: OPENCV_FFMPEG_LOGLEVEL=16 (AV_LOG_ERROR: decoder complaints are printed); counted per stream and never fatal — hiccups {'AMD-AMC-001': 0, 'AMD-AMC-002': 0, 'GNR-POL-002': 25}, frames decoded {AMD-AMC-001: 1861, AMD-AMC-002: 1829, GNR-POL-002: 995}

results.check: Pipeline handles mixed H.264/H.265 and mixed resolutions
results.evidence: catalogue advertises codecs ['H.264', 'H.265'] and 3 resolutions ['1280x720', '1920x1080', '704x576']; decoded this run: ['1280x720', '1920x1080']

results.check: Behaviour is sane across a scene discontinuity
results.evidence: a backwards jump or a >5s gap in stream position re-anchors the clock and is logged; observed this run: {'AMD-AMC-001': 0, 'AMD-AMC-002': 0, 'GNR-POL-002': 0} (total 0); no stream dropped as a result (3/3 still connected)
